newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to lower.

text.p: Spot millfeed prices were mostly steady to lower in quiet holiday activity, dealers said.
But one dealer said he expected some buying to be done by Thursday.
"I think we will see some activity because a lot of folks have not done anything yet for January and will probably look for next week alone," a Buffalo dealer said.
Another broker said the shortened holiday week has created some logistical problems.
Trucks loaded over the weekend could have trouble getting to their destinations on time this week, he said.
Dealers said that trading was very limited.
Some buyers appear to be delaying purchases and prices may be backing off, a Minnesota dealer said.
